1.9.1.title: Rotli fits in the Dock
1.9.1.body: The app icon is now the same size as your other apps, and Settings → App icon shows each choice as it really looks, including a new Black icon.

1.9.1.title: The Librarian organizes your copy
1.9.1.body: When Rotli makes a copy of an Obsidian vault or another folder of notes, the Librarian files loose notes into your own folders and adds summaries and tags. Your views, locked notes, and Obsidian's templates and attachments stay as they are.

1.9.1.title: Links follow your notes
1.9.1.body: Move, archive, or restore a note and Rotli updates the image and link paths inside it and the ones pointing to it. Only the path changes, never your words.

1.9.1.title: A smaller app
1.9.1.body: Rotli is about 8 MB smaller, and search and PDFs stay at full speed.

1.9.0.title: Bring your Obsidian vault
1.9.0.body: Connect a folder of notes as it is, or connect a copy for the Librarian to organize. Your own folders stay yours, notes keep their file names, and links still work in Obsidian. Your original folder is never touched by the Librarian.

1.9.0.title: Chat asks before it acts
1.9.0.body: Chat asks before it edits a note you wrote, asks you a quick question with options before writing something long, and says plainly why a message was held back, with Send anyway for words you typed yourself.

1.9.0.title: Reading mode
1.9.0.body: Press ⌥⌘R and everything but your note steps away: it stays beautified, takes no typing, and nothing reacts to the pointer. Esc brings you back.

1.9.0.title: Open anything from Finder
1.9.0.body: Open With → Rotli opens notes, boards, Word documents, spreadsheets, and CSVs, and Open in Rotli opens a whole folder in its own window. Nothing new appears beside your files.

1.9.0.title: Connect a model from Chat
1.9.0.body: The model menu has Connect a model…, and your first chat starts by showing every way in: models on this Mac, or your own Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Gemini.

1.9.0.title: A calmer chat list
1.9.0.body: One row per chat, a dot for a reply you haven't read, room to breathe between turns, and every model logo in its maker's colors.

1.8.1.title: Big folders stay light
1.8.1.body: A vault holding a code folder or tens of thousands of files no longer pushes rotli to gigabytes of memory: node_modules and .git stay out, and large folder trees open folded.

1.8.1.title: Opens faster, rests when idle
1.8.1.body: rotli shows its window right away and reads your vault in the background. Hidden documents and sheets stop redrawing, and background checks only run when they have something to do.

1.8.1.title: Quitting finishes saving first
1.8.1.body: Every window now finishes saving before rotli quits, so a large document or sheet is never cut off mid-save.

1.8.1.title: Secure files stay on your device
1.8.1.body: Documents, sheets, and CSV files in a secure folder never reach a cloud model, and secure workbooks saved by other apps stay private too.

1.8.1.title: Word and Excel files on the web (Beta)
1.8.1.body: Rotli Web now opens, edits, and creates Word documents and spreadsheets in your connected folder, saving them back as ordinary .docx and .xlsx files.

1.8.0.title: Spreadsheets, in Beta
1.8.0.body: New Sheet makes a real .xlsx, and .xlsx files open to edit. The toolbar is one row, Theme | White picks the sheet's colours, and ⌘C copies a whole column or block as a table.

1.8.0.title: Charts in your notes
1.8.0.body: Type /chart and pick one of ten kinds. The chart lives in the note as plain text you can read and edit, and it follows your theme's colours.

1.8.0.title: Ask AI from the note
1.8.0.body: Type /ai, say what you want, and read the answer before Insert adds it where you are. It never changes what you wrote, and a secure note never goes to a connected model.

1.8.0.title: Saving and undo just work
1.8.0.body: Sheets and Word documents save themselves a moment after you stop: Saving…, then Saved. ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z undo and redo in notes, sheets, documents, and boards.

1.8.0.title: Boards that behave
1.8.0.body: Links on shapes open, app hotkeys work while a board has focus, and panning is smooth. In Main, Remove from folder or a drag below the list takes a note out of its folder.

1.7.0.title: Rotli opens with a moment of its own
1.7.0.body: Every launch opens on a short scene in your theme with your quokka. Any key or click skips it, and Reduce motion turns it off.

1.7.0.title: Choose your sidebar
1.7.0.body: Turn Notes, Chat, or Breve off in Settings → Appearance, and pick which one Rotli opens on. With one left, the switcher steps aside.

1.7.0.title: A Vault view
1.7.0.body: Pick Vault above Main to see your folders the way Finder does. While it's open, the Librarian leaves anything you can see where it is.

1.7.0.title: Dates and project lists from /
1.7.0.body: Type /today, /yesterday, or /tomorrow for the date; in a template it fills in the day you use it. Continue a project list starts the next list once the last one's done.

1.7.0.title: Link note makes the note
1.7.0.body: Type a title that doesn't exist yet and choose Create to make the note and link it in one step.

1.7.0.title: Your theme, everywhere
1.7.0.body: Settings, an empty pane, and setup wear your theme's scenery, with drifting clouds and your quokka. Settings also got one width, joined controls, and a music volume.

1.7.0.title: AI edits only what it may
1.7.0.body: Chat, agents, and the Librarian change notes an AI made. A note you wrote stays yours unless you turn on Let AI edit the text.

1.7.0.title: Rename in place
1.7.0.body: Rename a note or folder right in its sidebar row: Enter saves, Escape keeps the old name.

1.6.0.title: Talk to the Librarian
1.6.0.body: Type /librarian in a note and ask it to tag the note, mark a passage, or file it. It proposes; nothing changes until you tick what you want and apply.

1.6.0.title: Hand a note to your AI
1.6.0.body: Hand to AI turns the note you're in into a ready prompt for Claude Code or another agent: the goal, the open tasks, and what done means. Type /hand to AI, or search for "send to AI".

1.6.0.title: Music while you write
1.6.0.body: Setup now asks about sound, and Settings → General → Ambient audio plays a studio track for your theme from a small player above the sidebar's footer. A video in a tab takes over, and the music comes back when it stops.

1.6.0.title: Claude FM and tucked tabs
1.6.0.body: Pick Claude FM, Anthropic's live lo-fi stream, as your ambient sound, and tuck a tab that's playing into the player to keep it going out of the way.

1.6.0.title: Show only what you use
1.6.0.body: Settings → Appearance → Show in Rotli hides the parts of the title bar, sidebar and tabs you don't need. Each switch says how to reach it without the button.

1.6.0.title: Bold that behaves
1.6.0.body: Bold, italic and the other marks now work across several lines and over text that's only partly bold, with no stray stars left behind.

1.6.0.title: Boards wear your theme
1.6.0.body: A board you haven't colored takes your theme's own color and changes with it. Prefer paper? Settings → Appearance → Board background → White.

1.6.0.title: Chat shows pictures and video
1.6.0.body: When a reply links an image or a video in your vault, you see it right in the thread.

1.6.0.title: Find lights up every match
1.6.0.body: ⌘F now marks every match on the page, and the current one stands out.

1.6.0.title: Tidier note names
1.6.0.body: Settings → General → Leftover note names clears old "Untitled" placeholders and half-typed titles from your notes' metadata in one click, and keeps any name a link still uses.

1.6.0.title: Three new quokka moods
1.6.0.body: Friendly, Inquisitive and Adventurous join the idle moods in Settings → Appearance.

1.6.0.title: A new web vault is ready at once
1.6.0.body: Tasks and your weekly counts include the Welcome lessons the moment your folder connects.
